notes: All 38 assigned previously-unmapped automated test files were read for executable scenario actions, expected outcomes, fixture/provider behavior and failure conditions. No tests were run.
Source mapping records intended scenario coverage only. It does not assert that tests currently pass, that mocked provider flows settle real trades, or that live tests were executed.
Debug activity injection, mocked relay/provider data and environment setup are test machinery; they do not create new consumer feature nodes.
Analytics staking-event tests and Connect silent-mode app-focus instrumentation are explicitly reviewed-excluded; underlying ordinary staking/signing features remain mapped elsewhere.
Guide article image enlargement was added as help.guide.images in services.json with implementation and test evidence.

A distinct wallet-label management leaf is recommended under wallet access. Existing wallet metadata tests exercise standard/hidden-wallet labels independently from hardware device name; sources provisionally reference the existing legacy/secure labeling capability.

The direct Connect Ethereum/Bitcoin signing tests map to the common external-transaction review node currently named connect.walletconnect.transaction; they do not establish WalletConnect pairing coverage. A future taxonomy cleanup could reparent this shared review capability without duplicating it.
No fixture addresses, transaction identifiers, passphrases, seed values or exact wallet balances were copied into the audit artifact.
